editorial: You feel the electric pulse of 1970s Manhattan press against your chest as shadows clash with ambition. You find yourself in the whirlwind of a young Donald Trump, guided by ruthless Roy Cohn, and the film reads more like a high-stakes chess match than a conventional biopic. Leonardo DiCaprio takes you on a razor-sharp journey with intense stare-downs that demand every edge of your attention. You might notice the early pacing lags, yet the second act snaps back with blistering tempo. You will love it if tense, character-driven dramas set against historic backdrops keep you coming for more.
targetAudience: Ideal for viewers who appreciate tense, character-driven dramas set against historic backdrops.
